name: kaist-real
notice: Barcode Dataset from Quick Browser and Smart Inference papers, Duy-Thao Do (KAIST), Zenodo record 13586402. Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
selection: Photos in real/img named by 13 digits alone, in baseline JPEG. Left out: crops of the WWU Muenster database (named DIGITS-01-2, non-commercial only), crops of ArTe-Lab photos (0510* and 0610*, which the ArTe-Lab list takes from ArTe-Lab itself, and IMAG* and PICT*, from ArTe-Lab's 1D Barcode Extended collection, which is not listed), progressive JPEGs, and 0898745031393.jpg, which also shows a Code 128 label.
